subject.title: fix(ci): bound opengrep install script downloads

question: Must this PR guarantee a deadline for every Opengrep installation network request, or is bounding only the initial installer-script fetch an acceptable incremental hardening?
rationale: The current patch is a valid incremental improvement, but its stated finite-install guarantee requires choosing and owning a broader CI supply-chain boundary.

options.title: Bound the complete install
options.body: Replace the installer invocation with a bounded direct asset download and checksum verification in both workflows.

options.title: Accept partial hardening
options.body: Land only the outer-fetch deadline after narrowing the PR claims and explicitly accepting that installer-internal requests remain bounded only by the 30-minute job timeout.

recommendation.title: Bound the complete install
recommendation.body: Replace the installer invocation with a bounded direct asset download and checksum verification in both workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the original OpenGrep workflow and installer design.
